verdict.rationale: Community evidence, including an apparent Proton reply, points to public source repositories at github.com/protonpass. Another commenter notes that only the clients appear to be open source, and an earlier user could not find the repository at launch, which was later resolved by the link. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the open-source status, the specific license named, server/backend source availability, and independent verification of the repositories' contents.
